title: Instructional Segment Embedding: Improving LLM Safety with Instruction Hierarchy
reasoning: The paper focuses on technical architectural improvements (ISE) for LLM safety and robustness against prompt injection and extraction. While it evaluates 'harmful requests' which include categories like 'Hate, Harassment, and Discrimination', it does so through the lens of safety alignment and security rather than a specific evaluation of moral reasoning, ethical frameworks, or religion.
